title: Cubit.js
tagline: Lightweight, dependency-free NxN Rubik's Cube state modeling and 2D net generation.
shortDescription: A lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript/npm library for modeling and manipulating NxN Rubik's Cubes and generating framework-agnostic 2D cube-net data.
description: Cubit.js is an open-source JavaScript/npm package developed as part of the Cubit ecosystem to model NxN Rubik's Cubes, execute verified transformations, and generate framework-agnostic 2D net visualization data without external dependencies.

caseStudy.problem: Rendering dynamic Rubik's Cube states across diverse web and mobile frameworks typically requires heavy 3D rendering engines or tightly coupled UI components.
caseStudy.solution: Built a zero-dependency pure JavaScript/ESM mathematical engine that parses WCA-style notation, performs immutable matrix rotations for 2x2 through 5x5 cubes, and exports deterministic 2D net data consumable by SVG, Canvas, React, or CSS Grid.
features: Immutable cube transformations for 2x2 to 5x5 cubes
Standard, prime, double, wide & multi-layer wide move parsing
Physically verified rotation matrices & color conservation
Comprehensive test coverage including M⁴ identity & randomized cross-validation
caseStudy.challenges: Ensuring exact physical correctness across multi-layer slice turns and corner/edge permutations across 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 cube dimensions without performance degradation.
caseStudy.outcome: Published open-source library with verified physical test suites, ready for consumption across web frontends, mobile frameworks, and visualization tools.
caseStudy.learnings: Deep dive into 3D-to-2D matrix mapping algorithms, immutable state transformations in JavaScript, and developer-friendly API design for npm libraries.
